---
name: Feature request
about: Something you wish this did, or did differently
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do** — the actual task/workflow, not the feature itself

**What's missing or awkward today** — what you had to work around, or couldn't do at all

**What you'd expect instead** — if you have a concrete idea, describe it; if not, that's fine, the gap itself is useful

**How you're using this** (self-hosted solo, team, evaluating it, etc.) — helps weigh how many people a given gap affects
